summary: The HR Manager provides HR support and direction on various programs and activities, focusing on employee and labour relations, recruitment, and professional development.
required_skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills
preferred_skills: Accreditation as a workplace harassment investigator
Experience in a public sector organization
education_requirements: Two year post-secondary diploma in HR Management
Post-secondary diploma in Office Administration or related field
responsibilities: Oversee recruitment and selection for all union and non-union positions
Develop and implement HR policies and training programs
Investigate work-related accidents and manage disability processes
requirements: Minimum of five years of HR, payroll and labour experience
Ability to handle sensitive issues with respect
Flexible working hours may be required
